title: Bounties
tagline: Innovative DeFi platform "BountyList" leverages smart contracts to streamline task completion and reward distribution, facilitating instant, on-chain bounties for digital tasks
description: "BountyList" revolutionizes task management and reward distribution within the DeFi space. Utilizing Arbitrum smart contract logic and Chilli rewards tokens, the platform offers a seamless interface for users to create, accept, and complete tasks. The project employs a dual-contract system: one for task management and another for handling rewards, ensuring a secure and efficient workflow from task listing to reward collection.
how_its_made:
The "BountyList" platform is built upon Ethereum smart contracts and a React-based frontend running on localhost thanks to ScaffoldETH2

Smart Contracts: Solidity for the TaskContract and RewardContract, handling task logistics and reward distribution.
Frontend: Next.js for a dynamic, user-friendly interface, integrated with ethers.js for blockchain interactions.
Deployment: Hardhat for compiling, testing, and deploying contracts to Ethereum testnets, ensuring thorough testing before mainnet launch.
User Experience: Web3.js and ethers.js were suppose to facilitate interactions between the frontend and the Ethereum blockchain, offering users a seamless experience of creating and completing tasks, as well as claiming rewards.
